messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: Azure AP South - GPU attach failures spike (alloc errors). Autoscaler attempts failing, queue backlog rising. Severity: P1. Notifying @oncall-alex and @sre-jordan.

oncall-alex: Ack. I'm on it — pulling metrics and checking autoscaler logs.

sre-jordan: Seeing attach denies from Azure: 
```
AllocationError: VMSS quota exceeded: VMSS target capacity blocked by subscription limit (Standard_NVIDIA GPUs)
```
Queue growth: +2100 pending requests in last 12m. Latency spikes to 12s token latency for generation jobs.

eng-runtime-lead: Is this a quota/region hardcap or VMSS drain? Any recent deploys to AP South?

infra-maya: No deploys. Looks like account-level GPU quota (per-region core/GPU limit) is hitting a hard ceiling. Azure reported: "quota limit reached for subscription" on attach APIs.

oncall-alex: Quick triage: can we temporarily route new low-priority traffic to eu-west while we triage? How impact is tiered?

pm-emma: Customer impact: Several PLG customers in APAC are seeing slowdowns on hosted endpoints. No major enterprise SLAs hit yet but latency and 5xxs rising. We should prep a status note if this remains >30m.

support-eli: We've already got ~12 tickets referencing timeouts for trial orgs in AP South. Escalating to engineering for mitigation.

eng-runtime-lead: Workable mitigations: 1) fallback routing to eu-west/central, 2) spin up smaller GPU instances (if available) as compatible model variant, 3) enable temporary CPU fallback for low-priority requests.

oncall-alex: Trying option 1 now: updating routing policy to prefer eu-west for new endpoints where consistency allows. Executing command: 
```
POST /routing/policy/update
{ "region_preference": ["eu-west1","ap-south1"], "selector": "endpoint:plg-*" }
```

ops-bot: Routing policy update accepted, change-id=chg_20240305_az_ap_fallback. Estimated behind-rollout: 45s.

infra-maya: I'll open an emergency quota request with Azure support — but approvals can take hours. Also checking if capacity exists in neighboring zones (ap-southeast2) to failover.

eng-runtime-lead: Meanwhile I'm enabling a degraded execution path that uses 8-bit quantized variants on smaller GPU families. Patch applied to canary, rolling to 20% traffic for compatible models.

oncall-alex: Canary shows reduced attach errors for the canary group but overall queue still high because most requests are pinned to large pools. Need broader rollout.

sre-jordan: Confirmed autoscaler logs showing repeated attach fail + requeue: 
```
autoscaler: scale_attempt(24)->attach_failed VMSSAttachError: quota_exceeded, retry=3
```
We've implemented backoff but stall persists.

pm-emma: Communication note ready. Will hold until we have a stable mitigation or 30m threshold. Triage owner: @oncall-alex.

infra-maya: Azure support case created: case# 12034567. Asked for quota bump and expedited review. Also requested temporary soft quotas in nearby region for failover.

oncall-alex: Handoff plan in 20m to next shift: @sre-jordan will continue monitoring and execute full fallback (route all PLG to eu-west) if queue doesn't drop below 300. I'll write a short runbook addendum.

eng-runtime-lead: Runbook addendum (snippet): 
```
If quota_exceeded and attach_failures > 1000:
  - set routing preference to eu-west for plg endpoints
  - enable quantized fallback globally: /config/models/quantize=true
  - mark affected pools read-only to prevent churn
```

support-eli: Adding proactive replies to impacted trial customers: "We are experiencing GPU capacity constraints in AP South; we are routing requests to alternate regions and expect restoration within a few hours."

oncall-alex: OK handing off. @sre-jordan you have the lead. I'll update the incident bridge notes and sleep. Posting final: :wave:.

sre-jordan: Taking over monitoring. Current metrics: pending_queue=1780, attach_errors_rate=85/min, successful_scaleups=2 in last 10m. If attach_errors_rate does not drop below 10/min in 15m -> escalate to infra on-call for cross-subscription mitigation.

ops-bot: Incident updated: severity=P1 -> active-mitigation, lead=sre-jordan, incident-url=https://incidents/internal/1719002222

sre-jordan: Executing broader fallback now: switching all PLG routes to eu-west, enabling global quantized fallback, marking large-GPU pools drain-only. ETA for traffic shift: ~90s.

oncall-alex: Thanks team. Keep updates tight and share any customer-impact changes.
